subject: a clear water meniscus on curved porcelain
pose: liquid edge curving across the lower third
art_direction: 透明水沿一片乳白曲面轻轻隆起，薄薄的蓝金反射形成安静曲线。
visible_description: 透明水沿一片乳白曲面轻轻隆起，薄薄的蓝金反射形成安静曲线。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Capture a clear water meniscus rising gently along a curved ivory porcelain edge. Its narrow blue-gold reflection forms one continuous line across the lower third, with no splash or suspended droplets. Use extremely soft side light to reveal transparency and surface tension. Let the porcelain curve blur gradually into a clean pale field for an almost abstract, meditative image. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
